title: Re-export toolDefinitions and toolMap from root index with deprecation notice

violation.problem: toolDefinitions and toolMap were completely removed from the main package entry point (@google/stitch-sdk), breaking existing imports without a deprecation window.
violation.expectedSolution: Re-export toolDefinitions and toolMap from packages/sdk/src/index.ts with @deprecated pointing to @google/stitch-sdk/tools. Rely on package.json sideEffects: false for bundle tree-shaking.
